interactions.name: construction_pose_inspection
interactions.action: During construction inspect visible owner transforms at minimum, midpoint and maximum finite settings, stowing prop before lid lowering. This is static joint-transform and binding inspection only; do not run endpoint/contact/load tests or physics trajectories.
interactions.expected: Native faces remain on their assigned roots and base prop pivot remains attached. Record visible geometry gaps without claiming a physical pass.

interactions.name: continuous_preview
interactions.action: Expose unwrapped wheel angle controls over at least one full turn with limited=false and no MJCF range or actuator position bounds. Inspect representative static transforms only.
interactions.expected: Native wheel faces rotate around estimated axles; accumulated angle is unbounded.

review_requirements: Construction integrity only: assign every native face exactly once, preserve source UV/material data, retain nonempty visible selections for each interactive owner and a separate cover_middle skin, and save the source-to-owner ledger. Fit individual key boundaries to actual seams; no moving stripe spanning multiple keys or wooden leg faces assigned to wheels. Preserve native rest appearance after frame conversion.

During construction use static joint transforms at configured minimum, middle and maximum finite settings to inspect lid, desk, prop, each sample key and each pedal. Verify visible surfaces follow only their intended owner and attachment edges remain plausibly connected. Stow the prop before lid lowering; fit the editable stow pose from rod/base geometry rather than treating an arbitrary quarter-turn as seated. Record exposed gaps honestly. This is visible binding inspection only, not a physical endpoint, contact or dynamics test; add no visual geometry under strict policy.

Compile each wheel hinge with limited=false and no range or finite actuator angle bounds. Use representative static quarter-turn and unwrapped greater-than-one-turn parameter settings to inspect rotating wheel faces and stationary forks; finite UI increments must not cap accumulated angle. Fit the axle to the visible wheel plane. Do not simulate rolling or claim transport.

Construct cover_middle as an actual connected coarse shell with proximal attachment to pedal_middle and a dedicated native skin using supported offset mapping. Inspect rest and bounded nonuniform parameter deformation up to the declared 0.005 m control, including with pedal rotation: the skin must visibly change shape and follow the pedal without a duplicate rigid sleeve. Retain other sleeves unchanged on their respective pedal owners. No load/unload, recovery or mj_step execution; label deformation as parameter preview.

Save usable GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF construction and interactive metadata promptly, then publish through the host. Distinguish planned controls, constructed working parameter controls and missing actions. Keep physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0; omit manufactured physical reports and trajectories, and do not invoke physics.py, simulate or verify_integration.

interaction_coverage.label: Main lid opening
interaction_coverage.reason: Broad raised panel meets straight case edge in front/top views; estimate longitudinal hinge and preserve a full 90 degree interval about closed prior.

interaction_coverage.label: Independent sample key presses
interaction_coverage.reason: Repeated narrow key surfaces support short independent lever presses. Three central individual keys are the explicit approximate preview subset; remaining individual keys are not claimed interactive.

interaction_coverage.label: Three independent pedal presses
interaction_coverage.reason: Three protruding pedals enter a common mount, supporting transverse hidden pivots. Small finite travel is a constrained press prior, not a reduced opening range.

interaction_coverage.label: Stow or deploy lid prop
interaction_coverage.reason: Rod is a separate case-attached support. Fold before lowering lid; it is not rigidly attached to both moving assemblies. Supported holding is a pose convention, no load-bearing claim.

interaction_coverage.label: Fold music desk
interaction_coverage.reason: Decorative upright sheet has a lower attachment line, permitting a bounded approximate hinge despite hidden fittings.

interaction_coverage.label: Caster axle rotation
interaction_coverage.reason: Rounded native caster ends support wheel spin. No angular stops, no swivel inference, no whole-object transport claim.

interaction_coverage.label: Local middle sleeve deformation
interaction_coverage.reason: Wrinkled cover supports a bounded visible nonrigid construction and parameter preview; not a physical test.

interaction_coverage.label: Other sleeves follow pedals
interaction_coverage.reason: Additional sleeve compliance deferred while middle sleeve has active deforming binding.

interaction_coverage.label: Remaining individual key actuation
interaction_coverage.reason: Native key detail is retained, but the initial approximate preview only articulates three central keys; complete keyboard coverage is missing.
interaction_coverage.attempt_plan: Additional build scope can partition each visually separable key by its actual native surface seams and instantiate the same short press mechanism; do not assume a conventional key count or claim this is implemented.

deferred_compliance.name: cover_left_deferred
deferred_compliance.reason: Preserve this additional sleeve unchanged on its moving pedal; middle sleeve is the one active coarse nonrigid region. No material-rigidity or deformation claim.

deferred_compliance.name: cover_right_deferred
deferred_compliance.reason: Preserve this additional sleeve unchanged on its moving pedal; middle sleeve is the one active coarse nonrigid region. No material-rigidity or deformation claim.

approximation_gaps.reason: Native interior, lid underside, key boundaries and tiny hidden pivots remain approximate; strict source surface preservation with no added visual reconstruction. Prop is independently hinged at its case end and must be stowed before lid closure.
Simple invisible box/capsule proxies omit fine key, sleeve and prop contact detail. No contact evaluation or collision-free claim.
One coarse middle sleeve skin only; other sleeves follow their pedals unchanged. Constitutive values are priors and preview deformation is not simulated.
